tour.title: Overview: Cargo Tracking in DDD
tour.description: cargotracker is a Django app organized into four bounded contexts: cargo, handling, location and voyage. The handling GLOSSARY.md defines the ubiquitous language (handling events, voyages, tracking IDs) used throughout. Start here for vocabulary.
tour.languageLesson: Each context uses domain / application / infrastructure / interfaces layers.

tour.title: Entry Point: URLs and Settings
tour.description: urls.py routes requests to the tracking views; settings.py wires installed apps (one per bounded context). wsgi/asgi are the server entry points.

tour.title: Location Context
tour.description: The simplest context: Location and UN/LOCODE value objects plus a repository interface that infrastructure implements with Django models.

tour.title: Voyage Context
tour.description: Voyages consist of a schedule of carrier movements, identified by a VoyageNumber and assembled with a builder.
tour.languageLesson: Builder pattern for constructing valid aggregates.

tour.title: Cargo Aggregate
tour.description: The core aggregate: Cargo with a TrackingId, route specification, itinerary of legs, and delivery progress.

tour.title: Delivery and Handling Activity
tour.description: Delivery derives a cargo's status from its handling history, including the next expected activity.

tour.title: Handling Context
tour.description: Handling events record real-world cargo actions; a handling history aggregates them and feeds delivery calculation.

tour.title: Persistence: Django Models
tour.description: Infrastructure models map domain objects to the database; repositories translate between them and migrations define the schema.
tour.languageLesson: Django ORM models kept separate from domain classes.

tour.title: Application Services and Composition
tour.description: Application services orchestrate tracking use cases; composition.py wires repositories into services.

tour.title: Tracking Interface
tour.description: Views and forms accept a tracking ID and present status, ETA, history and next activity as text.

tour.title: Map View and Templates
tour.description: The map sub-feature adapts cargo status into coordinates and renders it in an HTML frame; page templates present the tracking form and results.
